featured_reviews.review_text:
I would call Dillesh and Arohi 'mentors' more than tutors. From day one, I felt genuinely supported—not just as a student aiming for a score, but as someone with aspirations and anxieties. I highly recommend them to anyone serious about improving their GMAT score and finding direction in their MBA path.

featured_reviews.name: Amit Soni
featured_reviews.review_text:
I first came across Career Geek while casually browsing Instagram. Curious to learn more, I joined a demo session with Arohi, the Verbal CR instructor. Her clarity and structured teaching style instantly clicked with me, and I enrolled in the course.

Although I had attempted the GMAT before, I kept making avoidable mistakes—especially in Quant and DI. That’s where Dillesh’s guidance was a game-changer.  DCF method and other core concepts was concise yet thorough. He taught concepts for topics like Venn Diagrams, Probability, and Permutations & Combinations that made a big difference. His teaching style simplified even the toughest topics and made them feel approachable.

On the Verbal side, Arohi’s methodical breakdown of questions and her emphasis on writing "summary-statement" solving strategies transformed how I approached CR and RC. Her clear and strategic way of teaching helped me improve my accuracy.

One suggestion from my side, include 1-2 more classes of DI and more practice question, that is really necessary.

Overall, the focused and well-structured lessons from Dillesh and Arohi, along with their continuous support, have made my GMAT preparation much more effective and less stressful.

I recommend Dillesh sir to anyone who is weak at quant and DI and trust me, with his processes, any score improvement is possible.
